name: forearm
description: A robot-arm forearm link in PA12 SLS as a strut lattice: an octet lattice open on the flat faces, struts thickened where the solid link carries stress, a stress-graded rim round its edge and solid collars round the bearings.

blob.description: bosses and a round beam smooth-unioned: the link tapers from elbow to wrist

envelope.description: flat top and bottom, edges rounded 2 mm

bores.description: the 22 mm elbow and 16 mm wrist bearing seats

solid.description: the solid link: what gets analyzed, and the mass to beat

stress.description: von Mises of the solid link, worst load case, as a fraction of its peak

strut.description: strut diameter: 1 mm where the solid link is calm, 2.4 mm where it carries 60% of its peak

core.description: octet cells, 7 mm, node fillets 0.5 mm; node layers every 3.5 mm in z, one 0.5 mm under each flat face

fill.description: the lattice cut 0.5 mm inside the envelope, through the node layer under each flat face (a cut above it leaves 0.3 mm strut stubs)

collars.description: solid rings round the bearings, past the bosses: the bosses are solid

rimWall.description: rim 1 mm where calm, 2 mm where the solid link carries 80% of its peak

rim.description: a skin round the link's edge only: the flat faces stay open, so the lattice shows
